evidence.observation: Baseline ~6-7 ppm after purge and through ramp
Rose to 12 ppm at growth start
Rising steadily to 44.7 ppm (20.3, 29.2, 34.5 at intermediate events) while Ar flow stays at 100 sccm, suggesting air is getting into the tube
750.3 °C on setpoint; heater power ~46%, consistent; no sign of thermocouple fault
99.9 sccm matches setpoint; no MFC fault evident
Pressure gauge not installed; cannot verify atmosphere or tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: Need a tube pressure reading or a manual leak check (e.g., a pressure-hold test, or checking the exhaust bubbler/backflow) to tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage; characterization of the sample is not available yet.
